notes.title: Incredible Dracula: License to Relax is out now!
notes.content: [p]When Count Dracula inherits the legendary Dark Dreams Hotel, a once-glorious resort, he expects a grand legacy - but instead finds himself in a new nightmare.[/p][p]As Dracula prepares to restore the hotel to its former grandeur, he discovers that rival hotel owners—witches, werewolves, and magicians—are plotting against him. With his rivals getting up to no good, it’s up to you to help Dracula revive the hotel, outsmart the competition, and uncover hidden secrets lurking in the shadows. Gather resources, recruit legendary experts, and ensure the resort is ready for the grand reopening. But beware of the Ministry of Control and Prohibition, which has its own list of impossible demands![/p][p]Can you restore the Dark Dreams Hotel to its former glory? Or will Dracula’s inheritance become his greatest nightmare?[/p][p]Help Dracula out in Incredible Dracula: License to Relax![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644756/2f41efc6c56047df09375127b0d03932dfcb9ab5.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Upsell Features[/b] [/h3][p]65 levels to complete[/p][p]Step-by-step level guide[/p][p]Catchy downloadable Original Soundtrack[/p][p]Beautiful desktop wallpapers[/p][p]Collectible items[/p][p]Fill in the “Cursed Treasure” section[/p][p]Fill in the Dark Dreams section[/p][p]Achievements[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678990/Incredible_Dracula_License_to_Relax/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
